_note: Strings needed by the GDPR export / admin-action work. Not yet in constants/i18n.ts, so no code path calls t() with these keys. Add them to all three locales before using them.

cprDataExportBody._why: REPLACEMENT for the existing key. The shipped English reads 'We will send your data to your email within 30 days.' That was never true and is now wrong in a different way: app/(consumer)/profile/privacy-settings.tsx builds the file on the spot and opens the share sheet. Until this key is corrected, the screen deliberately does not use it.
cprDataExportBody.en: Your data has been collected into a file you can save or share. GDPR Article 20 — data portability.
cprDataExportBody.es: Tus datos se han reunido en un archivo que puedes guardar o compartir. RGPD Artículo 20 — portabilidad de datos.
cprDataExportBody.hu: Adataidat egy fájlba gyűjtöttük, amelyet elmenthetsz vagy megoszthatsz. GDPR 20. cikk — adathordozhatóság.

cprDataExportPreparing.es: Preparando la exportación de tus datos…

cprDataExportFailed.en: Could not build your data export. Please try again.
cprDataExportFailed.es: No se pudo crear la exportación de tus datos. Inténtalo de nuevo.
cprDataExportFailed.hu: Nem sikerült elkészíteni az adatexportot. Kérjük, próbáld újra.

cprDataExportPartial._why: Shown when GdprExportResult.unavailable is non-empty, so the subject is never handed a silently incomplete export.
cprDataExportPartial.en: Some of your data could not be read and is missing from this file.
cprDataExportPartial.es: Algunos de tus datos no se pudieron leer y faltan en este archivo.
cprDataExportPartial.hu: Néhány adatodat nem sikerült beolvasni, ezek hiányoznak a fájlból.

admFailLoadPromos._why: app/(admin)/promo-codes.tsx discarded the PostgREST error entirely; it now needs a message to show.
admFailLoadPromos.es: No se pudieron cargar los códigos promocionales
admFailLoadPromos.hu: Nem sikerült betölteni a promóciós kódokat

admFailLoadStats._why: app/(admin)/index.tsx discarded four query errors; the dashboard showed zeros instead of a failure.
admFailLoadStats.es: No se pudieron cargar las estadísticas del panel
admFailLoadStats.hu: Nem sikerült betölteni az irányítópult statisztikáit

admWriteRefused._why: A zero-row admin UPDATE is an RLS refusal, not a success. supabase-js reports no error for it, so the screens have to detect it from the returned row count and say so.
admWriteRefused.en: That change was refused — you may not have permission.
admWriteRefused.es: El cambio fue rechazado: puede que no tengas permiso.
admWriteRefused.hu: A módosítás elutasítva — lehet, hogy nincs jogosultságod.
